# Round Trip — write → read → append → read → delete cycle

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
exec akb template get adr --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/adr.yaml
exec git add .agent-kb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note and adr templates'

# --- Write a note page ---
stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write my-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/my-note.md'

# --- Verify file exists on disk ---
exists kb/notes/my-note.md

# --- Read the page back ---
exec akb read notes/my-note.md
stdout 'First content line.'
stdout 'type: note'
stdout 'title: My Note'

# --- Read with kb/ prefix ---
exec akb read kb/notes/my-note.md
stdout 'First content line.'

# --- Read with type-dir prefix ---
exec akb read notes/my-note.md
stdout 'First content line.'

# --- Append to the page ---
stdin ../append-input.md
exec akb append notes/my-note.md
stdout 'Appended to kb/notes/my-note.md'

# --- Read after append — both lines present ---
exec akb read notes/my-note.md
stdout 'First content line.'
stdout 'Second content line.'

# --- Frontmatter preserved after append ---
exec akb read notes/my-note.md
stdout 'type: note'
stdout 'title: My Note'

# --- Write an ADR page ---
stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write my-decision.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/my-decision.md'

# --- Verify ADR file exists ---
exists kb/decisions/my-decision.md

# --- Read ADR page ---
exec akb read decisions/my-decision.md
stdout 'ADR content here.'

# --- Delete the note page ---
exec akb delete notes/my-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/my-note.md'

# --- Verify note file is gone ---
! exists kb/notes/my-note.md

# --- Delete the ADR page ---
exec akb delete decisions/my-decision.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/decisions/my-decision.md'

# --- Verify ADR file is gone ---
! exists kb/decisions/my-decision.md

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: My Note
summary: A test note
tags: test
---
First content line.

-- append-input.md --
Second content line.

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: My Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: A test decision
tags: [test]
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-01-01'
---
## Context

Round-trip coverage needs a decision page. The cycle writes the page, reads it back, appends to it and finally deletes it, so the record has to survive every step unchanged. See [[my-note]] for the note side of the same cycle.

## Decision

ADR content here. The page keeps its frontmatter and its body through read and append.

## Consequences

The decision can be read back and deleted like a note. Deleting it removes the file and its index entry.
